item.title: SCP Idea: Pinular Gas
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): I don't really know how I would put this, so if you want to see the sandbox page just ask.

Elevator Pitch:
There's a gas that when inhaled causes negative affects on the victim.
*This gas slowly turns the victims into Wood.
*If the wood corpse of the victim has a piece remove, the piece removed will melt into a pile of skin-like material and blood that is classified as SCP-XXXX-2
*If the victim is taken to the desired area they have after inhalation, they will be free of the negative affects and mutate into SCP-XXXX-3.

Central Narrative: None at the moment, may have a new instance in the future.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The reason for this to stick out or to make it popular is for the following reasons:

  • It may be the first SCP to be a gas that upon inhalation begins a transformation process
  • After inhalation, the situation becomes life or death, as the subject must be transported to their desired location to survive.

Additional Notes: The last time I had posted, it ended up reaching -14 ratings, and that made me very disappointed in myself, so my goal is to make my SCP more likable.
Another goal of mine is to get some help with any grammar mess-ups on my article, as well as making the article's input more eloquent.
